decision_conditions:
We were unable to split the drawings, if you can please provide drawings as individual files.

Marketing report required.
 
We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
'Change of use of the first and second floors of the existing building from Class E (Office) to a mixed use, comprising  1no. 2 bedroom flat on the first floor and 2no. 2 bedroom flats on the second floor, with office space provided on the first floor. Erection of two balconies at first and second floor level on the Eastern and Southern elevations following removal external stairwell.'
